topic: Sakazuki exposed the Five Elders for spreading a false story to protect Doflamingo
title: Sakazuki Caught The Elders Lying For Doflamingo
description: After Dressrosa, Sakazuki confronted the Five Elders over a false story that protected Doflamingo. I think that fight shows who the Government really protects. Do you agree?
comment: Did the Elders protect Doflamingo because he was useful, or because he was one of their own? Pick one.

lines.text: Sakazuki caught the Five Elders lying to the whole world for Doflamingo.

shot.fallback: admiral in a white coat confronting five elders

lines.text: Doflamingo's Warlord resignation was announced to everyone, and it was false.

shot.fallback: headline about a king giving up his throne

lines.text: Law spotted it first. He said only a World Noble should be able to pull that off.
The Elders had helped spread the lie, to protect Doflamingo's empire.

shot.fallback: five old men in dark robes

lines.text: Sakazuki asked why the whole world had to be misled for one pirate.

shot.fallback: fleet admiral with a furious face

lines.text: The Elders said the Marines are only the World Government's public face.

shot.fallback: elders waving off a standing admiral

lines.text: He called them puppets of the Celestial Dragons, and they blamed him for Kuzan joining Blackbeard.
Then Fujitora announced Doflamingo's defeat before the Elders knew, so nobody could bury it.
Some say damage control. But that doesn't ignore the Fleet Admiral who wears the shame.
Here is my read: Doflamingo was worth more to them than their own Fleet Admiral.

shot.fallback: smiling man in sunglasses in shadow

lines.text: If protection isn't the prize, what is?
And once you see that, you understand exactly what happened when

shot.fallback: elders and an admiral in tense silence

self_check.hook: Line 1 names Sakazuki, the Elders and Doflamingo and states the confrontation.
self_check.loop: The last line ends on 'when' and flows into line 1.
